Third-party code bundled for local document reading
===================================================

PDF.js / pdfjs-dist 5.6.205
Project: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/5.6.205
License: Apache License 2.0. Full license: pdfjs/LICENSE.
Files copied from the provided runtime package: legacy/build/pdf.mjs,
legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs, cmaps/, standard_fonts/.
Individual font license files in standard_fonts/ are retained.

Mammoth 1.13.0
Project/source: https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js
Downloaded package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mammoth/-/mammoth-1.13.0.tgz
License: BSD 2-Clause. Full license: mammoth/LICENSE.
Browser bundle: mammoth/mammoth.browser.min.js.

These dependencies are served from this site. The importer does not upload
scripts or fetch third-party CDN code at runtime. PDF.js reads PDF text and
Mammoth extracts raw DOCX text; imported content is never inserted as HTML.
